title: LOLAI canonical scenario
description: A canonical training scenario including generation, lineage, split and review metadata that is not exposed to the model.

scenarioId.description: Globally unique opaque identifier of the scenario.

familyId.description: Opaque identifier grouping scenarios from the same semantic family.

splitGroup.description: Opaque group used to keep related scenarios in the same dataset split.

sourceType.description: How the scenario was produced or curated.

parentScenarioId.description: Opaque identifier of the source scenario, or null for a root scenario.

counterfactualPairId.description: Opaque identifier shared by a counterfactual pair, or null when not applicable.

episodeId.description: Opaque temporal episode identifier, or null for a standalone scenario.

episodeStep.description: Zero-based position within a temporal episode, or null for a standalone scenario.

causalSignature.description: Stable signature describing the causal factors that determine the expected decision.

reviewStatus.description: Current state of the scenario review workflow.

expectedOutput.description: Expected model output for this scenario.
